completion:
Include for both fires:
   - a.) The key document
   - b.) Why the documents indicate a fire-safety failure
   - c.) How the failure was reflected in fire-safety practice
3. Consider including a copy of the document as an appendix.

---

## Instructions for crafting the narrative

1. Each story must include the following:
   - a.) A title
   - b.) Location of the building
      - i.) City and State or Country
   - c.) A detailed explanation of the date of the fire
   - d.) The date the building was built
   - e.) Use of the building (residential, etc.)

2. Write the Case Study
   a.) Minimum 1 page in length
   b.) In narrative form4. Include all sources on a 'Sources' page at the end.
   a.) URLs to at least five reliable links.
